newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS-U.S. T-bond vols plummet after jobs data.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-U.S. T-bond vols plummet after jobs data.

text.p: Implied volatilities for U.S. debt options ended sharply lower as underlying markets rallied immediately after a brief sell-off on the August U.S. eoployment report, dealers said.

Market-makers started taking out the weekend time-decay by midsession, adding to the pressure on volatilities which had been pumped up to relatively rich levels earlier in the week ahead of the jobs data, they added.
"There were so much expectations on the number," said a Treasury bond trader for a brokerage at the Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT).
